answer_1.quote: Referring expression generation (REG) aims at generating utterances that help anchoring an object within an image. Such descriptions are called referring expressions (REs).

answer_2.quote: In order to measure the naturalness of referring expressions we use the standard automatic metrics that have been used in REG that compare the generated referring expression with the human ones: BLEU 1 for unigrams, CIDEr and METEOR.
